title: Dreams and Dream Stories
author: Anna Bonus Kingsford
description: "Dreams and Dream Stories" by Anna Bonus Kingsford is a collection of dream narratives written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This work presents a series of vivid, imaginative dreams and fantastical stories that reflect the author's philosophical musings and spiritual inquiries, intertwining fantastical elements with deeper meanings related to human experience, morality, and the nature of reality.

authorInfo.bio: Anna Bonus Kingsford (1846–1888) wrote Dreams and Dream Stories. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
